agency.name: Division of Mental Health and Addiction (DMHA), Indiana Family and Social Services Administration

countyDirectory.name: DMHA — Community Mental Health Centers by County (Individuals Receiving Services)

narrNote: INARR is listed as Indiana's affiliate on NARR's official affiliates page (narronline.org/affiliates); DMHA is the state designating authority for recovery residences. Verified in-run 2026-10-22.
notes: Indiana 211 is a division of FSSA; its public portal (in211.org) presents a CommunityOS sign-in screen to automated access, so the verified FSSA Indiana 211 page is linked instead (dial 2-1-1 or 866-211-9966, or text ZIP code to 898-211). Agency phone is FSSA's published line shown across DMHA pages. Medicaid SUD coverage runs through the Indiana Health Coverage Programs (IHCP) under Indiana's Section 1115 SUD demonstration, which expanded coverage for residential and IMD treatment. Indiana Recovery Network (a program of Mental Health America of Indiana) coordinates regional recovery hubs and certifies recovery community organizations statewide.
